settings.eyebrow: Glossline Detailing · Mobile + in-shop · Ceramic, correction & interior
settings.headline: Showroom shine, delivered to your driveway.
settings.copy: We're not a quick spray-and-wipe car wash. Every Glossline detail is a multi-stage process — decontamination, machine correction, coating, and a cabin so fresh it smells like the day you took delivery. Book in-shop or we'll bring the studio to your driveway.

trust_list.text: Mobile service across the metro area
Every car gets a written care plan

stats.label: Year coating warranty on our flagship package

settings.title: One studio,
settings.intro: Every Glossline package starts with a full decontamination wash and a careful inspection. From there, choose how far you want to go — and we'll tell you honestly which package your paint actually needs.

design.title: Exterior maintenance detail
design.text: A pH-neutral wash, clay-bar decontamination, wheel-and-tire work, and a hand-applied sealant. The perfect monthly reset for a car you actually drive.

design.title: Interior refresh
design.text: Steam extraction, leather conditioning, and every vent and seam vacuumed. We work around your schedule so you're never without a car for long.

build.title: Single-stage polish
build.text: Removes swirls, light scratches, and oxidation with one machine pass, restoring that wet-glass reflection without burning clear coat.

build.title: Two-stage paint correction
build.text: Cutting and polishing compounds to tackle deeper marks, followed by a finishing polish. This is the step that makes people ask, 'Is that the same car?'

launch.title: Ceramic coating
launch.text: A 5-year to 7-year coating that locks in your corrected paint, sheds water, and shrugs off bird droppings and bug acid. Includes surface prep and a full aftercare plan.

launch.title: Paint protection film
launch.text: Invisible self-healing film on the front bumper, hood, mirrors, and rockers — the armor behind the shine for daily drivers and weekend toys alike.

settings.title: More than
settings.intro: Anyone can make a car look clean for an afternoon. Glossline makes it look right for years — here's the difference you can't see in a parking-lot detail.

features.title: Certified, not trained-on-the-job
features.text: Every technician holds current ceramic and PPF certifications and trains on a fleet of test panels before touching a customer car.

features.title: We measure, not guess
features.text: Gloss meters and paint-thickness gauges tell us what's actually happening to your clear coat — not just what looks shinier.

features.title: Warranties we stand behind
features.text: Our coatings carry up to a 7-year manufacturer warranty, and we back every install in writing — not just with a handshake.

features.title: Mobile, on your schedule
features.text: A fully equipped van brings the studio to your driveway or office lot, so you don't lose a day waiting at a shop.

features.title: Interior done right
features.text: Steam, extraction, and correct products for leather and Alcantara — a cabin that feels new, without the chemical burn-off smell.

features.title: Honest condition reports
features.text: We tell you what your paint actually needs and what it doesn't. No inventing work to pad the ticket.

settings.title: From 'needs help'
settings.intro: Here's what a Glossline detail looks like, start to finish — so you know exactly what we're doing to your car before we ever pick up a buffer.

steps.title: Book & get a quote
steps.text: Tell us your make, model, and condition. You get a firm quote and a window — no surprise upsells once the car is in the bay.

steps.title: Decontamination wash
steps.text: A thorough pre-wash, foam bath, and clay treatment strip the bonded grime so the paint is bare and ready to work.

steps.title: The correction
steps.text: Our technicians machine-polish to your package's target, measuring gloss and paint thickness at every stage.

steps.title: Protect & deliver
steps.text: Coating or sealant goes on, the cabin gets its final touch, and you receive a written care plan for keeping the finish.

settings.note: Glossline is built on measurable results: gloss readings before and after, paint-thickness logs on every panel, and a walkaround with you before the keys go back.

settings.title: What drivers
settings.intro: We asked a few owners what changed after their Glossline detail. Their answers were about pride, resale, and the feeling of the first drive home.

reviews.quote: I bought a 2014 truck that had been parked under a tree for two years. Two-stage correction and a ceramic coat later, a stranger at the gas station offered to buy it. I'm keeping it — it's like a new truck.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: They came to my office parking lot and detailed my daily driver while I worked. The interior has never smelled this clean, and the paint is glossy a year later. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Priya S.

reviews.quote: I was skeptical about the gloss-meter readings until I saw them pre- and post. My black car finally looks black again — no swirls at all. These people actually care about paint.
reviews.author: Jordan K.
